table_definitions.events: CREATE TABLE "events" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "base_server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_local" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_server" INTEGER NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "application_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'applied', "delivery_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "rejection_reason" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("event_id"))
table_definitions.event_refs: CREATE TABLE "event_refs" ("event_ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "relationship" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_ref_id"))
table_definitions.sales: CREATE TABLE "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_event_id" TEXT NULL, "last_event_id" TEXT NULL, "last_server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "cliente_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clientes (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'borrador', "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_local" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_local" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(status IN ('borrador', 'descartada', 'confirmada')), CHECK(total_minor >= 0 AND total_minor <= 9007199254740991))
table_definitions.sale_items:
CREATE TABLE "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_event_id" TEXT NULL, "last_event_id" TEXT NULL, "last_server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "consumption_configuration_key" TEXT NULL, "product_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "sale_mode_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NULL, "measured_quantity_atomic" INTEGER NULL, "unit_price_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "standard_cost_minor_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "price_reference_quantity_atomic_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "sale_unit_code_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "sale_unit_symbol_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "sale_unit_atomic_factor_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(unit_price_minor > 0 AND unit_price_minor <= 9007199254740991), CHECK(total_minor >= 0 AND total_minor <= 9007199254740991), CHECK(standard_cost_minor_snapshot IS NULL OR (standard_cost_minor_snapshot >= 0 AND standard_cost_minor_snapshot <= 9007199254740991)), CHECK(sort_order >= 0), CHECK((sale_mode_snapshot = 'unit' AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 AND quantity <= 9007199254740991
      AND measured_quantity_atomic IS NULL AND price_reference_quantity_atomic_snapshot IS NULL
      AND sale_unit_code_snapshot IS NULL AND sale_unit_symbol_snapshot IS NULL AND sale_unit_atomic_factor_snapshot IS NULL)
      OR (sale_mode_snapshot = 'measured' AND quantity IS NULL
      AND measured_quantity_atomic IS NOT NULL AND measured_quantity_atomic > 0 AND measured_quantity_atomic <= 9007199254740991
      AND price_reference_quantity_atomic_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND price_reference_quantity_atomic_snapshot > 0 AND price_reference_quantity_atomic_snapshot <= 9007199254740991
      AND sale_unit_atomic_factor_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND sale_unit_atomic_factor_snapshot > 0 AND sale_unit_atomic_factor_snapshot <= 9007199254740991
      AND sale_unit_code_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(sale_unit_code_snapshot)) > 0
      AND sale_unit_symbol_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(sale_unit_symbol_snapshot)) > 0)))
